secrets.name: The Napkin
secrets.hint1: Rexach signed the boy on a napkin in a little restaurant - the family kept everything from those days. Check the old cafe's drawer marked miscellaneous, Rosario Quarter.
secrets.hint2: Some fool filed a treasure under 'miscellaneous.' The cafe's fenced yard, Rosario Quarter.
secrets.memory: Barcelona, 2000: a restaurant table, a paper napkin, and a signature that changed football.

secrets.name: The Ball-Boy Medal
secrets.hint1: 1993, Swiss Indoors - a ball boy got a medal from Michael Stich himself. Roger never forgot. It is in the clubhouse trophy cabinet, behind the loose panel.
secrets.hint2: A champion's first medal was not won - it was given. Clubhouse porch, Basel Lawn Club.
secrets.memory: Basel, 1993: a boy in whites catches a champion's medal - and a promise.

secrets.name: Page One of the Plan
secrets.hint1: Richard wrote it all down - seventy-eight pages, starting at page one. Sachin keeps a copy in the Hall Library's sports section, inside a tennis manual.
secrets.hint2: A father's handwriting. Seventy-eight pages. Start at one - the library shelves by the plaza.
secrets.memory: Compton: a plan in a binder, cracked courts, and two sisters who believed it.

secrets.name: Earl's Old Glove
secrets.hint1: Earl's old glove - he left it on the driving-range bench at the Navy tee, before dawn rounds. Tiger never moved it.
secrets.hint2: A glove worn soft by a father's hands - old Navy tee, Cypress Links.
secrets.memory: Cypress, before dawn: a father, a son, and a glove that smelled like cut grass.

secrets.name: The One-Rupee Coin
secrets.hint1: Achrekar sir put a one-rupee coin on the off-stump - bowlers who got the boy kept it. The last coin was never claimed. It is still at the nets.
secrets.hint2: A coin worth one rupee, worth a billion memories - middle stump, Bandra nets.
secrets.memory: Shivaji Park, 7 AM: a coin on the stump, and a boy who would not get out.

secrets.name: The Cha-Cha Medal
secrets.hint1: Before Jeet Kune Do, there was the cha-cha - Hong Kong champion, 1958. Sifu kept the medal in the dojo storage shed, behind the curtain. Said dancing taught him footwork.
secrets.hint2: A dancer's medal in a fighter's dojo - check the storage shed, Kowloon.
secrets.memory: Hong Kong, 1958: a trophy for dancing - footwork before fists.

secrets.name: The Bicycle Bell
secrets.hint1: Before the gloves, there was a red-and-white Schwinn. Stolen, October '54. The champ never forgot the sound of that bell - the lost-and-found crate went down the gym's cellar stairs years ago.
secrets.hint2: The gym's cellar stairs go down further than the gym. Listen for the bell.
secrets.memory: Louisville, 1954: a stolen bicycle, a furious boy, and an officer who said 'learn to box first.'

secrets.name: The Split Staff
secrets.hint1: Gramps' old staff - Goku broke it training as a boy and kept it anyway. It is at the mountain shrine, behind the falling water.
secrets.hint2: Behind the waterfall on Mount Paozu - the water hides a door.
secrets.memory: Mount Paozu: a lonely house, a grandpa's keepsake, and a boy with a pure heart.

changes: String lights appear across Rosario Quarter (lamp tiles lit at dusk).
Two kid NPCs spawn in the plaza kicking a ball.
Cafe El Rincon gains a 'napkin framed on the wall' POI.
Bunting strung across Bandra Nets; 'Sachin, Sachin' chant ambience near the oval.
Firework sparkles over the cricket oval at dusk.
Mural wall plaque text updates: '...and the wait was worth it.'
Olympic torch plinth lights with an eternal flame VFX.
Gym kids chant 'Ali, bomaye!' on approach.
Desert training ground gains a second ring (sparring).
Dojo lanterns lit along the Hong Kong street.
Be Water pond gains koi sparkles; plaque glows.
Training dummies replaced by a live sparring partner NPC.
Clubhouse flower boxes bloom (flower tiles added).
Ball kids rally on the grass courts (ambient animation).
Trophy cabinet plaque: '20. The gentleman's game, perfected.'
Sunday-red flag on the 18th green; flagstick glows.
Pro shop hut opens: vendor NPC sells palette-swap costumes.
Fist-pump statue POI added near the green.
Court three's chalk lines repainted in gold.
Yetunde's garden blooms; new bench dialogue.
Catsuit tribute banner at the Macci academy sign.
Waterfall glows at dusk; pure-heart stone pulses.
A drifting cloud (Nimbus homage, original art) circles the peak.
Training hut gains a weighted-gear rack POI.

rules: All 8 districts walkable from game start - exploration is never gated.
Life portals require met_<goat> only (one conversation).
Story NEVER gates behind medals or golds (per brief).
District warp unlocks on visited_<zone> (Pokemon Fly-style).
Secret-area exits are always open; retry is always free.
